scope: Force contacts: 5N/2N hysteresis, 10ms persistence, <20ms chatter removal; contact correlation and support fractions alone do not define a gait

load_balance.definition: Time-mean positive contact normal force includes swing zeros; peaks/impulses use complete hysteresis-filtered stances. On this flat floor normal is vertical. Front/rear equality is not assumed.
